summary: Full backend + frontend regression of the new ETI Educom features. Backend: 34/34 pytest assertions pass (/app/backend/tests/test_eti_new_features.py) — all 13 lead endpoints accept valid payloads and each one was verified to forward to the live CRM webhook in backend logs (including Job Application source); Announcements/Placed Students/Partners(recruiter)/Events/Blogs CRUD + auth enforcement + 404s all pass; 20 programs present. Frontend: announcement bar, Our Recruiters, Placed Students (horizontal scroll incl. mobile), Recent Events (past-dated, 3 available) all render; admin panel login with TOTP 2FA works and Placed Students / Announcements add flows + Partners 'Recruiter' option all work; real lead form (free-counselling) submits end-to-end and shows thank-you page. TWO significant frontend defects found: (1) CRITICAL header/announcement-bar overlap making the whole top nav unclickable after any scroll, (2) HIGH all 8 recruiter logos are broken images (logo.clearbit.com does not resolve).

minor.issue: Validation error message surfaced to the admin UI is the raw Pydantic string 'String should have at least 1 character' with no field name — admin cannot tell which field failed (happens when the required Student Photo is left empty; the modal has no client-side required check).
job_id is accepted without verifying the job opening exists (a fabricated job_id 'test-job-1' was stored and forwarded to CRM). Consider validating job_id.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: After scrolling, the sticky header slides underneath the announcement bar and the entire desktop/mobile top nav becomes unclickable. Verified: header.getBoundingClientRect().top becomes 0 while .announcement-bar occupies 0-40px with z-[60] vs header z-50; elementFromPoint on the 'Contact' nav link returns DIV.announcement-bar and a normal Playwright click times out (element intercepts pointer events). Header logo and nav are also visually clipped. RCA: Header.jsx line 118 sets className={`header-main ${scrolled ? 'scrolled' : ''}`}, which overwrites the 'with-announcement' class that AnnouncementBar.jsx adds imperatively via classList.add, so .header-main.with-announcement{top:2.5rem} is lost on the first scroll re-render. Fix by driving the announcement state through React (context/prop/store) or by CSS (e.g. body.has-announcement .header-main) instead of imperative classList on a React-controlled element. Same problem affects .main-content padding.

HIGH: All 8 recruiter logos render as broken images on the homepage AND in the admin Partners tab. Seeded logo_url values all point to https://logo.clearbit.com/ and that host does not resolve (DNS ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED from the container; Clearbit's free Logo API has been retired). 16/16 in [data-testid="recruiters-track"] have naturalWidth === 0. Two fixes needed: (a) reseed recruiter logos with hosted/uploaded assets, (b) add an onError fallback in RecruitersSection.jsx so the company name text (already implemented for the no-logo case) is shown instead of a broken image icon.

Student Photo is marked required (*) but the form submits without it and only fails server-side with a 422; no client-side validation and no data-testid on the photo URL input / 'Save Placed Student' button (only name/company/position have testids).

issues: Announcement text is truncated to '🎓 Admissions Open for 2026 batc...' (scrollWidth 628 vs clientWidth 260); consider a marquee/smaller font/2-line layout on mobile so the offer is readable.
Only 3 completed events exist so the 4-column grid leaves an obvious empty 4th column on desktop; seed a 4th completed event or use a centered/auto-fit grid.
WhatsApp 'Need help?' chat bubble overlaps section content/stats near the bottom-left together with the AI chat widget and the sticky bottom bar — crowded bottom-left corner.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix header/announcement-bar overlap — stop mutating .header-main className imperatively from AnnouncementBar; keep 'with-announcement' when Header adds 'scrolled' (React state/context or body-level CSS class). Top nav is currently unclickable on every page after scrolling.
HIGH: Replace the logo.clearbit.com recruiter logo URLs (host is dead) and add an name fallback in RecruitersSection.jsx (and admin Partners cards).

MEDIUM: Add client-side required validation + data-testids for the Student Photo input and Save button in the admin Placed Students modal; surface friendly field-level validation errors instead of raw Pydantic messages.
LOW: Seed a 4th completed event so the homepage 'Recent Events' 4-card grid is full; improve mobile announcement text truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx:118 `className={`header-main ${scrolled ? 'scrolled' : ''}`}` fights AnnouncementBar.jsx's document.querySelector('.header-main').classList.add('with-announcement'). Never mix imperative classList mutation with React-controlled className on the same node — this is the root cause of the nav overlap.
server.py is 4950 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (leads, content, admin, seo, partners/placed-students).

RecruitersSection/PlacedStudentsSection swallow fetch errors with empty catch blocks and simply render null; there is no loading or error state, so a backend outage silently removes homepage sections.
POST /api/applications does not validate that job_id references an existing job opening before storing and forwarding the lead to the CRM.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all new sections and admin flows functional; 1 critical nav overlap + broken recruiter logos)

rca_of_the_issue: Header nav unclickable: AnnouncementBar.jsx adds the 'with-announcement' class to .header-main imperatively (classList.add) inside a useEffect. Header.jsx renders className={`header-main ${scrolled ? 'scrolled' : ''}`}; on the first scroll React re-renders and overwrites the class list, dropping 'with-announcement'. The header then returns to top:0 where the announcement bar (fixed, top:0, z-[60]) sits above the header (z-50), covering the logo and the whole nav row (measured header.top=0, bar.bottom=40, nav link rect top=18/bottom=54) so document.elementFromPoint on nav links returns the announcement bar and clicks are intercepted. Reproduce: open homepage, scroll ~1500px, try to click any header nav link. Mitigation: manage announcement visibility in React state shared with Header (context) or toggle a class on <body>/<html> and target `body.has-announcement .header-main` in globals.css.
